'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
**[[2025 Gaza Strip aid distribution killings]]
***At least 73 [[Palestinians]] are killed while seeking [[humanitarian aid]] in the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://news.sky.com/story/gaza-live-latest-israel-hamas-idf-war-famine-aid-13398805 (Sky News)]
**[[Gaza Strip famine]]
***The [[Israeli Air Force]] begins [[humanitarian aid]] drops over the [[Gaza Strip]] amid growing international pressure to allow food into the [[Palestinians|Palestinian]] [[enclave]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cn437jjygl9o (BBC News)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**[[2025 Shabelle offensive]]
***[[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|Al-Shabaab]] seizes control of the central [[Somalia]] town of [[Mahas, Somalia|Mahaas]] in the [[Hiiraan]] region following a ground [[offensive (military)|offensive]]. The attack began with multiple [[suicide bombing]]s just outside the town, followed by heavy gunfire, prompting the [[Somali National Army|army]] and local [[Ma'awisley]] [[militia]]s to withdraw. [https://thesomalidigest.com/al-shabab-retakes-mahaas-as-federal-forces-target-jubaland-instead/ (''The Somali Digest'')] [https://apnews.com/article/somalia-town-captured-alshabab-4ccf935efc09dcc9264412919d2e2068?utm_source=copy&utm_medium=share (AP)]
*[[2025 Cambodia–Thailand border conflict]]
**[[Cambodia]] and [[Thailand]] agree to [[negotiate]] a [[ceasefire]] following [[mediation]] efforts by [[United States Secretary of State]] [[Marco Rubio]] the previous day. However, both sides accuse the other of violating the ceasefire. [https://apnews.com/article/thailand-cambodia-armed-clash-border-ceasefire-ae1ca49539793aeaf0ce71d4d1cf42a0 (AP)]
*[[Allied Democratic Forces insurgency]]
**[[Komanda town massacre]]
***[[Allied Democratic Forces]] [[militant]]s attack the city of Komanda, [[Ituri province]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], killing 43 people, including 20 during a [[Vigil (liturgy)|vigil]] in a Catholic church. [https://www.radiookapi.net/2025/07/27/actualite/securite/carnage-en-ituri-une-attaque-des-adf-fait-43-morts-et-dimportants (Radio Okapi)]
*[[New People's Army rebellion]]
**Seven [[New People's Army]] [[guerrilla]]s are killed in a [[military operation]] in [[Uson]], [[Masbate]], [[Philippines]], as [[Armed Forces of the Philippines|Philippine troops]] pursue remaining insurgents. [https://apnews.com/article/philippines-communist-guerillas-insurgency-3b0935ca43a138de7a3bd9283a419787 (AP)]
*[[War on drugs in Ecuador|Ecuadorian Drug War]]
**Seventeen people are killed and 14 others are injured after gunmen [[Mass shooting|open fire]] on a [[Bar (establishment)|bar]] in [[El Empalme, Ecuador]]. The shooting is believed to be linked to a conflict between local [[drug cartel]]s for control of [[Illegal drug trade|drug trafficking]] routes. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c8jp7w43vvmo (BBC News)] 

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Baden-Württemberg train derailment]]
**At least three people are killed, including a railway employee and the driver, and around 50 others are injured, including 25 seriously, when a [[Deutsche Bahn]] [[Regional-Express]] train carrying 100 people derails in [[Baden-Württemberg]], [[Germany]]. [https://www.tagesschau.de/inland/zugunglueck-baden-wuerttemberg-100.html (ARD)]
*Twenty-five people are killed, 26 others are rescued, and 49 are reported missing when a large wooden boat capsizes in [[Niger State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://halifax.citynews.ca/2025/07/27/boat-capsizes-in-nigerias-niger-state-and-at-least-25-people-feared-dead-authorities-say/ (CJNI-FM)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/thirteen-dead-dozens-missing-nigeria-boat-accident-2025-07-27/ (Reuters)]
*At least six people are killed and 27 others are injured in a [[stampede]] when a high-voltage electric wire falls on a path at the [[Mansa Devi Temple, Haridwar|Mansa Devi Temple]] in [[Haridwar]], [[Uttarakhand]], [[India]]. [https://apnews.com/article/crowd-surge-hindu-temple-haridwar-india-deadly-782ce8f71be77c29b3ec5ba25bd70b93 (AP)] [https://ca.news.yahoo.com/least-6-people-killed-stampede-050622102.html (''The Independent'' via Yahoo! News Canada)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Tariffs in the second Trump administration]]
**[[United States–European Union relations]]
***[[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] and [[European Commission president]] [[Ursula von der Leyen]] announce a trade deal that would set a reciprocal 15% [[tariff]] on all exports and promise to boost [[European Union]] investment into the U.S. by $600 billion. The EU also promises to purchase $750 billion in [[Energy in the United States|American energy]] products over an unspecified period of time. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cx2xylk3d07o (BBC News)]
*[[North Korea–Russia relations]]
**[[Russia]]n airline [[Nordwind]] launches the first [[commercial flight]] from [[Moscow]] to [[Pyongyang]], [[North Korea]]. [https://apnews.com/article/north-korea-russia-tourists-beach-resort-c2a979822196745ec5592ed7c067830b (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Capital punishment in Iran]]
**[[Iran]] executes two members of the exiled terrorist group [[Mojahedin-e-Khalq]] on charges of carrying out attacks on residential, education, and government buildings. [https://apnews.com/article/mujahedeen-activists-executed-iran-dbff689584c96b44b8641f91f0a69353 (AP)]
*Three people are killed and ten others are injured in a [[mass shooting]] in [[Turks and Caicos]], whose authorities are deeming it the first mass shooting in recent history, due to an increase in violence spilled over from the [[Gang war in Haiti|gang war]] in [[Haiti]]. [https://apnews.com/article/turks-caicos-mass-shooting-018be7b697a4af2f32b18c7191a28aaf (AP)] [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/turks-and-caicos-islands-mass-shooting/ (CBS News)]

'''Sports'''
*[[UEFA Women's Euro 2025]]
**In [[association football]], [[England women's national football team|England]] defeats [[Spain women's national football team|Spain]] 3–1 on [[Penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalties]] in the [[UEFA Women's Euro]] [[UEFA Women's Euro 2025 final|final]] to win their second major football championship and successfully defending their title. Spain's [[Aitana Bonmatí]] is named the tournament's best player. [https://www.reuters.com/sports/soccer/kelly-hero-england-sink-spain-shootout-win-euro-2025-2025-07-27/ (Reuters)]
